name: Lemon Rasam
steps: Rinse moong dal and simmer with turmeric and 500 ml water for 25 minutes until it breaks down easily. Mash lightly without draining the cooking liquid.
Add chopped tomato, crushed ginger, slit chilli, salt and the remaining 600 ml water. Simmer for 7–8 minutes until tomato softens and the broth smells fragrant.
Heat ghee in a small pan and pop mustard, then cumin. Add curry leaves carefully and pour this tempering into the simmering rasam; turn off the heat.
Wait 2 minutes, then stir in lemon juice and coriander. Do not boil after adding lemon; taste and serve the light broth hot, with rice separately if desired.
notes: Base recipe for 4 adults. Cooking times are estimates; follow the texture and doneness cues. Jain suitability follows your saved ingredient choices.
